about: Texturizer's tools for agents (through Agent Link): name, what it does, its arguments as JSON Schema, its group, whether it changes the document. The texturing is BumpMesh's engine (Stefan Hermann, CNC Kitchen) ported to Python.

texture_list.description: BumpMesh's texture library as Texturizer ships it: id, name, category (geometric, patterns, organic, fabric, natural, grip, mold, tires, custom), credit and licence, and defaults (scaleU in mm). Filter by category or a name search. Changes nothing.
texture_list.source: Texturizer for FreeCAD; the library is BumpMesh's (Stefan Hermann, CNC Kitchen)

texture_settings.description: BumpMesh's settings: names, defaults, units, mapping modes 0-8, layer and run keys. With a body (and texture, settings): the predicted triangle count and memory at refineLength, BumpMesh's suggested refineLength and maxTriangles for the texture, and a fitted cylinder axis. Changes nothing.

settings.description: BumpMesh settings by name (texture_settings lists them): per layer e.g. scaleU (mm per tile), textureHeight (mm), mappingMode (0 planar XY, 1 planar XZ, 2 planar YZ, 3 cylindrical, 4 spherical, 5 triplanar, 6 cubic, 7 surface normal, 8 outline wrap); for the run e.g. refineLength (mm), maxTriangles, bottomAngleLimit.

texture_settings.source: Texturizer for FreeCAD; settings and estimates ported from BumpMesh (Stefan Hermann, CNC Kitchen)

texture_draft.description: Start or read the texture draft, the one the Texturizer sidebar shows: part (a body or Mesh object; a Textured object brings back the settings it was made with, to texture it again), draft (a whole draft), reset (BumpMesh's Reset to defaults), project (a .bumpmesh file: BumpMesh's Load Project, mode all or settings). Opens the sidebar in the window. Answers the part, its triangles and faces, and each layer: texture, Cover/Add, include/exclude and its faces, the settings changed from BumpMesh's defaults. The engine and settings are BumpMesh's (Stefan Hermann, CNC Kitchen), ported.

project.description: A .bumpmesh path ("ask" opens a file dialog in the window).

layer.description: The layer, from 0 (bottom); the sidebar's active one when left out.

texture_draft.source: Texturizer for FreeCAD; the engine and the settings are BumpMesh's by Stefan Hermann (CNC Kitchen), ported to Python and credited (AGPL-3.0)

texture_set.description: Change the draft (a partial update, one undo step; the sidebar's sliders move as it runs): texture (a library id, or {file} for your own heightmap), settings by BumpMesh's names for the layer and the run (texture_settings lists them, e.g. scaleU mm per tile, textureHeight mm, mappingMode), frame (rotation [x, y, z] degrees as BumpMesh's Rotate, or face: Place on Face), cylinder (autofit, reset, from_face with face), stamp (on, off, or {point, normal} for Position on model), active (the layer the sidebar edits). Nothing changes in the document.

layer.description: The layer, from 0 (bottom); the sidebar's active one when left out.

texture.description: A library id (texture_list), or {"file": a PNG path} for your own map.

settings.description: BumpMesh settings by name (texture_settings lists them): per layer e.g. scaleU (mm per tile), textureHeight (mm), mappingMode (0 planar XY, 1 planar XZ, 2 planar YZ, 3 cylindrical, 4 spherical, 5 triplanar, 6 cubic, 7 surface normal, 8 outline wrap); for the run e.g. refineLength (mm), maxTriangles, bottomAngleLimit.

face.description: Place on Face: a face name, or "selected".

stamp.description: on, off, place (the clicked spot), or {point: [x, y, z], normal: [x, y, z]}.

texture_set.source: Texturizer for FreeCAD; the engine and the settings are BumpMesh's by Stefan Hermann (CNC Kitchen), ported to Python and credited (AGPL-3.0)

texture_mask.description: BumpMesh's Masking, By Surface, for one layer: mode exclude (these faces stay plain) or include (only these faces get the texture; switching clears the layer's faces, as BumpMesh), add or remove faces, add_by (direction, box or surface, from the picked faces or faces), fill (BumpMesh's Fill from seed faces, or seed triangles on a Mesh part, across edges under maxAngle degrees), triangles (a Mesh part), paint (BumpMesh's Brush: strokes of hits on the part, Circle or Single, Size, Hardness, erase; each stroke one undo step), clear (Clear All). The sidebar's face list lights as it runs. Nothing changes in the document.

layer.description: The layer, from 0 (bottom); the sidebar's active one when left out.

add.description: Faces: names (Face3), a list, or (with Agent Link) queries such as {"normal": [0, 0, 1]}. Or "selected".

remove.description: Faces: names (Face3), a list, or (with Agent Link) queries such as {"normal": [0, 0, 1]}.

faces.description: Faces: names (Face3), a list, or (with Agent Link) queries such as {"normal": [0, 0, 1]}.

fill.description: Seed faces, or {faces, maxAngle}; on a Mesh part (or with triangles) {triangles: [seed indices], maxAngle, erase}.

paint.description: BumpMesh's Brush on the part's tessellation. A stroke is a list of hits; a hit is {point, normal, triangle} (triangle and normal optional: the nearest is used) or [x, y, z]; null breaks the stroke. The Circle brush paints the triangles connected to the hit within Size / 2 (seen along view, else into the surface); Hardness under 100 fades the paint per vertex to the rim. Each stroke is one undo step.

type.description: The sidebar's Type when left out.

erase.description: Erase, as Shift in the window.

texture_layer.description: BumpMesh's layer strip (up to 4 layers, bottom first): add (a copy of the active layer, Include Only, made active), remove, move (delta -1 up / +1 down), solo (shows only it in the preview), visible, blend (cover or add on the layers below), name, active. Nothing changes in the document.

value.description: solo / visible: true or false; blend: cover or add; name: text.

texture_preview.description: Build the CPU preview of the draft with BumpMesh's engine (the same code as the export, so what shows is what prints) and wait for it: shown in the 3D view, answered with the preview edge, triangles, time, and the export's edge, triangles and memory. quality draft (500 k triangles) or fine (1.5 M). suggest: BumpMesh's Suggest values (resolution and triangle limit, set in the draft). cancel stops a running preview. Look at it with view_snapshot.

layer.description: The layer, from 0 (bottom); the sidebar's active one when left out.

texture_apply.description: Add to document / Update / Bake Textures with BumpMesh's engine (Stefan Hermann, CNC Kitchen), ported to Python and run inside FreeCAD; the body is never changed. With no texture or layers it textures the draft the sidebar shows (draft: a whole draft first) and makes a Textured Mesh object, or updates the one this draft made (new: true for another). update: a Textured object's name, run again with the settings it stores (an object goes out of date when its body changes and reruns only here). bake: BumpMesh's Bake Textures, the result (undecimated) becomes the part with a fresh layer; with bakeMask on (the default) that layer excludes the faces just textured. Or one texture (texture, faces, mode) or up to 4 layers, bottom first, each {texture, settings, faces, mode include|exclude, blendAdd}; a layer without its own texture, faces or mode takes the top-level one, and one that differs is refused. settings' layer settings are every layer's defaults. settings: BumpMesh names. rotation [x, y, z] degrees: BumpMesh's Rotate. Optional export STL / 3MF. Answers triangles, repair, warnings and the credit; texture_check { object } checks the result. Refuses a run that would need more than memoryLimitGB (4).

texture_export.description: Write a file: format stl or 3mf (object: a Textured object as it is; else the draft run by BumpMesh's engine), or bumpmesh (BumpMesh's Save Project: the settings, the part's model unless model is false, your own textures unless texture is false). path: where (relative: the output folder; the window asks when left out). 3MF and STL carry the credit.

layer.description: The layer, from 0 (bottom); the sidebar's active one when left out.

texture_prepare.description: A body made ready for a surface texture by BumpMesh: an STL written face by face from one mesh of the whole part, and a mask file of the triangles of faces (names or queries) — mode include (texture only them: a grip) or exclude (all but them: keep a mating face plain). Answers the bumpmesh_texture_file call to make with it, then how to check the result against the body.
texture_prepare.source: Written for Agent Link for FreeCAD's draft tools; moved to Texturizer 14 Nov 2026

texture_check.description: Check a textured mesh against the body it was made from, face by face: on each face the texture was for, the share of points moved and how deep (p95, out, into); leaked — faces meant to stay plain that moved (a mating face, a datum); bare — faces meant for texture that barely moved; and whether the mesh is closed. object: a Textured object texture_apply made — its body and mask come from what it stores, and its own mesh is checked (or path: its texture_export STL, found by itself). For an STL textured outside FreeCAD: body, path and mask (texture_prepare's -mask.json, found beside it by name); tolerance as texture_prepare used. Faces BumpMesh's angle limits cover whole are listed as angleMasked. verdict ok or check. Changes nothing.

object.description: A Textured object (texture_apply's): its body, mask and mesh.

flat.description: mm a point may move and count as unmoved (0.01).
